caption: One record takes 4 ms to parse, 6 ms to validate and 2 ms to format, so it leaves the pipeline 12 ms after it enters. Validate is the slowest stage, and that 6 ms sets the pipeline's capacity at 1 ÷ 0.006 s ≈ 166.7 records per second.

spec.aria: A timeline in milliseconds where one record is parsed from 0 to 4, validated from 4 to 10 and formatted from 10 to 12, with a bottom lane spanning 0 to 12 showing the 12 ms latency and the validate stage picked out as the slowest stage.
